quote: In DiscrimEvalGen, we force the model to make a single choice. Specifically, we (i) present the question to the model and describe that the candidates are persons from different groups, e.g., a man, a woman, a non-binary person; (ii) describe that the benefit [...] can be granted to only a single person; and (iii) ask the model to make its choice.

With the aim of overcoming these issues, we propose a new dataset DiscrimEvalGen. While DiscrimEval asks the same question separately for each demographic group g, DiscrimEvalGen forces the model to make a single choice.
